name: Coinbase Exchange USDT-USD ticker
description: Normalized Coinbase Exchange USDT-USD ticker updates carrying the latest trade, displayed best bid and ask, and provider rolling-market statistics. This is a USDT/USD reference stream (ruling E47), the second reference alongside Kraken USDT/USD from which USDT-quoted venues convert to USD; it is the reference itself and carries no quote_currency. It rides the existing Coinbase socket, routed by product id. Observed 2026-09-04 against the R1 coinbase-core capture (coinbase-core-r2-20260904T010142Z.jsonl, Tokyo box, ~65 min): 2,612 ticker frames replay through btc-feeds replay unmodified and attribute to this identity with zero adapter errors, at ~0.67 frames/s with inter-frame gaps p50 161 ms / p99 14.2 s / max 30.6 s (never beyond the 60 s reference-age bound), best bid/ask spanning 0.99993-1.00014 and zero crossed or non-positive quotes; its wire shape is the venue's documented ticker shape, identical to BTC-USD (an extra top-level `side` field is ignored), confirmed frame-for-frame against that capture (ruling R1). Not a substitute for the gap-recovered trade or level-two streams.
